# AI Trading Agent

Version 5.13.12. This package contains the complete, self-contained AI Trading Agent skill.

Read the [skill guide](./skills/ai-trading-agent/README.md), [installation prerequisites](./skills/ai-trading-agent/INSTALL.md), and [example prompts](./skills/ai-trading-agent/EXAMPLE-PROMPTS.md).

The full skill includes research, paper analysis and host-dependent native broker handoff and execution instructions. Actual broker actions require supported host tools and user authority. Installing this package does not connect a broker or authorize trades.

Python helpers run only when invoked in a permitted host environment with their prerequisites. No backend, daemon, MCP server or always-on service is bundled or required.

This GitHub marketplace distribution is separate from approval or publication in the public OpenAI Directory. See the bundled [MIT license](./LICENSE).
